Investors read a seed deck in the order you give them, so the order is your first argument.

This carousel walks through an opening that keeps the reader going: purpose in one sentence, the problem, the solution, then the market. Each slide says what goes on it and what to keep for the meeting.

Our full pitch deck guide is linked in the first comment.

linkedin.text:
Before the first line of code, spend a week talking to people who have the problem you want to solve.

Ask about the last time it happened, what they tried, and what it cost them. Keep your idea out of the call until the end: people are polite about ideas and precise about their own week.

We keep our guides for first-time founders in one place, linked in the first comment.
